description: This file defines the default engine configuration and shaft position emulator shape for an Audi AAN engine in the rusEfi EFI firmware project. It includes a function to configure the shaft position emulator and sets default engine configuration parameters.

methods.name: void configureShaftPositionEmulatorShapeWhat(PwmConfig * state)
methods.description: Configures the shape and parameters of the shaft position emulator for the engine, setting pin states and switch times.

methods.name: void setDefaultEngineConfiguration(EngineConfiguration * engineConfiguration)
methods.description: Sets default parameters for the engine configuration, particularly the shaft position event count.
